title: Chapter 26 Reporting Work, Is A War About To Start?
content:
Chapter 26 Reporting Work, Is A War About To Start?

Inside the main hall of the city lord's mansion.

Lu Daosheng sat at the top.

A long time ago, after a guy's suggestion, the City Lord's Mansion would conduct a work report every once in a while.

This made Lu Daosheng feel like he was going to work.

And today is the time to report on work.

At this moment, Awei, An Xing, Yun Qi and others had already been waiting in the hall.

Everyone was straight and looked at Lu Daosheng above with a serious and respectful look on his face.

Seeing this scene, Lu Daosheng was not surprised. He touched his nose and said in a low voice: "Awei, come first."

"Yes, Lord City Lord."

Immediately, Awei stepped forward and reported to Lu Daosheng all the important things that happened in the deserted city these days.

The number of people in the deserted guards led by Awei has reached tens of thousands.

After all, there are many people in the deserted city now, and it may be inconvenient if the deserted guards have too few people.

Roughly estimated, there are at least a few million people in the deserted city today, and it is probably going to exceed tens of millions in a short time.

Of course, the local area is definitely not a problem.

After all, when Lu Daosheng rebuilt the wasteland city, he injected the world laws and space laws. The entire wasteland city was as huge as a world.

Not to mention tens of millions of people, even hundreds of millions of people are more than enough.

Soon, Awei finished the report.

Because Awei is in charge of discipline and security issues in the deserted city, there will be no big trouble.

The next moment, An Xing stepped forward.

Five hundred years have passed, and An Xing’s temperament has obviously undergone tremendous changes.

Back then, he was still a street stalker who was hiding in the land of nothingness, but now he has become the leader of a huge organization, and his whole body exudes the aura of a superior.

In the eyes of Lu Daosheng and others, he is a gentle and smiling guy.

In the eyes of outsiders, it was like a demon god, and his expression changed when he heard it.

It is precisely because An Xing did a good job that Lu Daosheng was completely relieved about the things in the wasteland city.

Because the roots have almost penetrated the entire deserted city, the number of people is as many as 100,000.

As long as everyone has any wrong thoughts about Huangcheng, An Xing will erase everything as soon as possible.

Since An Xing's leader is a force in the dark, he is responsible for intelligence collection, assassination and many other things, the reporting time is longer than A Wei.

It was not until the afternoon that An Xing finished reporting.

"City Lord, that's all."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng nodded.

If he continues, he will fall asleep.

At this time, Yunqi stepped forward.

In five hundred years, Yun Qi has lived up to Lu Daosheng's expectations and has built a super powerful army for Lu Daosheng.

Lu Daosheng named Lu Family Army.

The entire army now has as many as 300,000 people, and it is still increasing. Every soldier is even armed to his teeth, which is extremely luxurious.

"Lord, everything in the army is now nothing different, but,

"Just what?"

Upon hearing this, Yun Qi's face suddenly turned a little bitter.

"My Lord, it's been hundreds of years since the establishment of the army, but there is no war. The brothers of the army are already hungry and thirsty."

In fact, it was not just the people in the army, he was the same.

He established an army for Lu Daosheng with passion, but there was no war to fight.

It’s like a man who just took medicine but failed to perform. He was really frustrated.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng was a little amused.

This is actually the case.

Then he can't take the initiative to provoke a war.

His philosophy is that if people don’t offend me, I won’t offend others.

But if there is really someone who is not afraid of death who dares to provoke him, then he will definitely make the other party pay the most painful price.

In place, Lu Daosheng directly deduced it with his great magical powers.

After a while, Lu Daosheng's expression changed slightly, and then he smiled and said, "Okay, continue to train troops well next time. After a while, you will be busy."

Hearing this, Yun Qi looked happy.

"Okay, then I will definitely train my troops well and will not let the city lord down. I will say goodbye."

Immediately, Yun Qi left directly.

Looking at Yun Qi who was leaving excitedly, Lu Daosheng shook his head and smiled, and then continued to listen to the report of the rest of the hall.

......

Above the walls of the deserted city.

Huang Shou slowly stood up, and six regular words were written on the wall beside him.

"Tsk tsk tsk tsk, how long has it been since the enemy arrived? My sword is so hungry."

Suddenly, the blood sword in his hand began to buzz, as if he was catering to his master.

In the past five hundred years, many powerful people who felt the aura of treasures in the deserted city rushed to the deserted city to snatch the treasures.

However, he couldn't even enter the city gate and was directly killed outside the city gate with one sword.

The strongest among them is even an ancient realm.

When Huang Shou saw the powerful man in the ancient realm, he was a little surprised because Lu Daosheng told him that many powerful men from the Xuan Gu Galaxy would come to try to seize the treasures these days.

It will take some time for the strong men outside the Xuangu Galaxy to come.

Therefore, the Xuan Gu Galaxy should not have the ancient powerhouses.

He knew that the Xuangu Galaxy was just a level 4 galaxy before, and it only began to change until the arrival of the deserted city.

It was not until he killed the other party with one sword that he realized that it was just a person who accidentally smuggled here from the passage.

Originally, the other party should be invincible in the Xuangu Galaxy.

But in the end, I came to the deserted city.

Looking up at the endless starry sky, Huang Shou looked calm.

No matter who comes, he just needs to kill it with one sword.

......

At this time, at the boundary of the Xuangu galaxy.

Although the Xuangu Galaxy is only a fourth-level galaxy, its border barrier is not something that ordinary strong people can break.

However, with a blast sounded.

The strong border barrier suddenly exploded into a huge hole.

The next moment, a black warship filled with strange aura slowly sailed out from it.

"Haha, I didn't expect that such a galaxy would even appear."

Above the bow of the ship, a man in black looked at the Xuangu Galaxy in front of him and said with a wicked smile, his eyes full of contempt.

On the side, an old man whose teeth were almost gone, said, "Young Master, let's act quickly. This treasure is not only discovered by our Xieyun Sect."

Hearing this, the man in black nodded and then said, "Go forward at full speed."

Suddenly, the black warship speed suddenly accelerated a little.

The Evil Cloud Sect is the strongest force in the Dark Galaxy.

The Dark Galaxy is a secondary galaxy.

However, there is a big gap in strength between galaxies of the same level.

Both are secondary galaxies. Even if some secondary galaxies only have one ancient powerhouse, they can be called secondary galaxies.

However, there are many ancient galaxies, more than one, but there are no strong people above the ancient galaxies, which are also called second-level galaxies.

The Dark Galaxy is the best among the secondary galaxies.

Just in their Xieyun Sect, there are three ancient powerhouses on the surface.

This time, the Xieyun Sect directly brought two ancient powerhouses, and it was obvious that they were bound to win the mysterious treasure that suddenly appeared in the Tianxuan world.

At the same time, within another boundary barrier.

Another huge hole appeared in shock.

The next moment, an extremely huge sword slowly emerged from it.

This giant sword is as huge as a small planet.

And there are countless creatures on it.

"Is this a low-level galaxy?"

On the head of the giant sword, a middle-aged man in a robe said coldly.

Looking at the Xuangu Galaxy, my eyes were filled with contempt, as if I was high above.

"Sword Master, this Xuan Gu galaxy is over. This time, the treasure appears in Xuan Gu galaxy. It's a pity that they do not have the corresponding strength to protect it. I'm afraid that there will be a big battle in this Xuan Gu galaxy. At that time, Xuan Gu galaxy will definitely There will be no grass growing."

Hearing this, the middle-aged man nodded and said no more.

Their opponents were never Xuan Gu galaxies, but other galaxies who came to seize the treasures like them.

However, they will be more cautious.

Because, who knows when those terrifying first-level galaxies will come?
